aggregation_semantics: counted at printing grain
grain: one row per card printing, unique on uuid and on the integer id
semantic_filter: One row per card printing; no deduplication by name is applied when the question counts cards.

aggregation_semantics: identifier, not aggregated
semantic_filter: Use when the question asks for a card id rather than for the card's uuid.

aggregation_semantics: compared for equality or used to list names
grain: one row per card printing; 11170 names occur on more than one printing
semantic_filter: Matching a named card returns every printing of that name across all sets.
validation: name is free text, never NULL in observed rows

aggregation_semantics: identifier, not aggregated
semantic_filter: The join key between cards and sets.
validation: cards.setCode joins to sets.code with 0 unmatched rows

aggregation_semantics: compared for equality
semantic_filter: The human-readable set name used when a question names a set, e.g. Coldsnap, Eighth Edition, Hour of Devastation.
validation: Coldsnap/CSP, Eighth Edition/8ED, Hour of Devastation/HOU resolved

aggregation_semantics: selected as text, not aggregated
grain: one row per (set, language) pair; 121 sets times 10 languages
semantic_filter: A non-empty translation is required; 231 of 1210 rows carry an empty translation despite the language row existing.

aggregation_semantics: compared for equality
semantic_filter: Artist names are free text and must be matched exactly, including punctuation and spacing.
validation: 991 distinct artist strings; 3 rows with NULL artist

aggregation_semantics: grouped or compared for equality
grain: one row per card printing and format
semantic_filter: One row per (card printing, format) pair.
validation: 15 distinct formats; 427907 rows; 0 duplicate (uuid, format) pairs

aggregation_semantics: compared for equality against Legal, Banned or Restricted
grain: one row per card printing and format
semantic_filter: Read together with the format column of the same row.
validation: only the values Legal, Banned and Restricted are observed

aggregation_semantics: counted per card uuid
grain: one row per ruling record; 87769 rows
semantic_filter: Join to cards on uuid to attribute a ruling to a card printing.
validation: every rulings.uuid matches a cards row (0 orphans)

aggregation_semantics: compared for equality; counted per value
semantic_filter: Value domain black, borderless, gold, silver, white.

aggregation_semantics: compared for equality or tested for NULL
semantic_filter: Text column; numeric comparison requires care and the markers '*' and NULL are not numbers.
validation: 30624 NULL, 429 equal to '*', remainder numeric strings

aggregation_semantics: compared for equality or by substring on the letter
semantic_filter: Comma-separated colour letters; a colour-name question must be translated to its letter, black to 'B'.

aggregation_semantics: compared as list membership
semantic_filter: Comma-separated list; multi-type printings such as 'Artifact,Creature' must be matched as list members, not by equality.

aggregation_semantics: compared as list membership
semantic_filter: Comma-separated; NULL for 22228 printings.

aggregation_semantics: compared as list membership
semantic_filter: Comma-separated; NULL for 48982 printings.
validation: 7322 printings have both supertypes and subtypes present

aggregation_semantics: compared for equality
semantic_filter: Printed type line; NULL for 14766 printings. Exact equality is narrower than list membership on types.
validation: originalType = 'Artifact' selects 2093 printings, all of which are also Artifact in types

aggregation_semantics: compared for equality or listed
semantic_filter: Not to be confused with frameEffects.

aggregation_semantics: matched as a substring
semantic_filter: Substring matching on free text; NULL for printings without a text box.

aggregation_semantics: compared for equality; counted per language
grain: one row per card printing and language
semantic_filter: One row per (card printing, language) rendition.
validation: 16 languages; Chinese Simplified on 20106 rows, Italian on 28698 rows

aggregation_semantics: compared for equality
grain: one row per set and language
semantic_filter: One row per (set, language) rendition.

aggregation_semantics: counted as distinct card uuid values having at least one matching language row
grain: one row per (card printing, language) rendition; 229186 rows
semantic_filter: Availability is established by the existence of a row for the card's uuid in the requested language.
validation: 16 rows reference a uuid absent from cards

aggregation_semantics: counted or compared as a flag
semantic_filter: 1 means the printing is promotional.

aggregation_semantics: counted or compared as a flag
semantic_filter: 1 means the printing has no text box.

aggregation_semantics: counted or compared as a flag
semantic_filter: 1 marks a Story Spotlight printing.

aggregation_semantics: counted as rows where both identifiers are non-null
semantic_filter: Read together with cardKingdomId in the same row; availability requires both identifiers to be present.
validation: cardKingdomFoilId NULL on 27910 rows, cardKingdomId NULL on 13622; both present on 25061

aggregation_semantics: compared as a flag on the set of the card in question
semantic_filter: 1 means the set is available only outside the United States.

aggregation_semantics: count of qualifying card printing rows; the denominator of a percentage question is the count over the population the question names
semantic_filter: Counts card printings, not distinct game-piece names.

aggregation_semantics: count of qualifying printings divided by the count of the scoped population, scaled to a percentage
semantic_filter: Both numerator and denominator are counts over cards rows; the denominator must come from the question's scope.
validation: borderless printings are 241 of 56822, i.e. 0.4241 percent

aggregation_semantics: count of ruling rows sharing the card's uuid
semantic_filter: Counted per card uuid after joining rulings to cards.
